description: Suggests meeting times when everyone named is free. Takes the attendees' addresses, a duration and a time range, and reads their free/busy along with the connected account's own. Returns candidate start and end times inside working hours, in order of time, each as an ISO time and as a local time in the time zone used. Working hours default to 9 to 17 in the account's primary calendar time zone, and weekends are skipped unless include_weekends is true. Starts fall on the quarter hour. An attendee whose free/busy cannot be read (another organization that does not share it, or a misspelled address) is listed under could_not_check, and the suggestions then leave that person out. The range can span at most 31 days. Nothing is booked; calendar_create_event books a chosen slot.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

attendees.description: Comma-separated email addresses of the people to find a time for.

duration_minutes.description: How long the meeting is, in minutes (5 to 480).

include_self.description: Whether the connected account's own calendar counts as busy time (default: true).

include_weekends.description: Whether Saturdays and Sundays can be suggested (default: false).

max_suggestions.description: The most slots to return (default: 5, at most 20).

time_max.description: End of the range to search (ISO 8601), at most 31 days after time_min.

time_min.description: Start of the range to search (ISO 8601).

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone working hours are read in, such as "Europe/London" (default: the primary calendar's time zone).

working_hours_end.description: The hour the working day ends, 1 to 24 (default: 17).

working_hours_start.description: The hour the working day starts, 0 to 23 (default: 9).

name: gws-mcp__calendar_suggest_time
